title: Where to put Suspense around lazy code

slides.say: A lazy component suspends while its code downloads. Something above it must show a fallback.
Wrap the lazy component, or any of its parents, in Suspense. Here the heading and the preview both wait behind one fallback.

slides.text: React doesn’t start loading until the lazy component first renders.
slides.say: React does not call the load function until the first time you try to render the component.

slides.text: Load fails? The error goes to the nearest Error Boundary.
slides.say: If the import fails, React throws the error to the nearest Error Boundary.
